notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
You have the highest life total.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding one mana of any color.
The creature dies, triggering Last Laugh, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Polyraptor triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the damaged Polyraptor, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.
